visualCharacteristics.summary: Vertical list of credit-card tabs (card name + card image) beside a panel with "Benefits for <card>" heading, View Details / Apply Now links and a benefits animation video or image.

contentPattern.structure: One row per card: cell 1 = tab label (heading with card name + card image); cell 2 = panel content (heading, links, image, .mp4 link for video) or a single link to a fragment (e.g. /fragments/cards/platinum-maxima-plus) that is loaded when the tab is first opened.

usage: Vertical list of credit-card tabs (card name + card image) beside a panel with "Benefits for <card>" heading, View Details / Apply Now links and a benefits animation video or image.

suitableFor: choosing between several products, each with its own detail panel
